name: frontend-design-ui-ux
description: Produce a distinctive, LOCKED design language plus an implementation-ready UX/UI spec, written to `.ulpi/design/`: a per-brief visual identity (palette, type, signature), the design system to build on, user flows and states, component briefs, and accessibility constraints. Commits to a bold aesthetic direction, bans AI-slop by name, and locks the identity so every screen and future session stays consistent. Can visit inspiration links with the browse skill to extract real design DNA. Ends with a build handoff that a delegated engineering agent implements — a DESIGN-SPEC skill that produces the spec, never production UI code. Use for new features, redesigns, or design-system work where the build should follow a locked spec.
author: ulpi-io
